system.description:
Trained to serve a noble house, an embassy or a merchant prince, and as useful in a council chamber as in a crisis.

  • Warded Table: as a 1-minute ritual, ward a meal, a drink or a small area against poison and scrying for 8 hours; anyone partaking is alerted if either is tried. Allies within 10ft of you have Advantage on checks to avoid surprise.
    • 9th level: the ward can cover a whole room, and you learn who tried to break it.
  • Practised at Court: Advantage on checks involving etiquette, protocol, or reading the political temperature of a room.
